entityDescription:
For more than 100 years, Ottobock develops innovative products. Meanwhile, the med-tech company also takes care of the full treatment cycle all over the globe. These services are provided under the Ottobock SE & Co. KGaA name, which began in 2018 to channel the company’s med-tech expertise also into sustainably healthy workplaces.
We continually develop our company and perfect our technology to improve the lives of our users. In 2019, we invested 9% of our turnover of product sales in research and development.
Since 1919 products and technologies from Ottobock have been helping people gain new freedom of movement and avoid potential complications. Initially, the company revolutionised the market – above all treatment for patients – thanks to the series production of prosthetic components. Since then, the focus has turned to microprocessor-controlled knee joints such as the C-Leg (which can be controlled via an app), the computer-controlled C-Brace leg orthosis, the multi-articulating bebionic hand, Juvo power wheelchairs and the Paexo exoskeleton range for ergonomic workplaces.
Our single-minded determination to improve quality of life has made us a global leader in technology for wearable human bionics, which enhance or replace parts of the human body.

entityDescription:
Nantes Université is a higher education and research institution with a new University model unprecedented in France as it brings together a university, university hospital (CHU de Nantes), technology research centre (IRT Jules Verne), public scientific and technological institute (Inserm) and s higher education institutions (Centrale Nantes, École des Beaux-Arts Nantes Saint-Nazaire, École d’Architecture de Nantes).

Working together, the actors combine their expertise to develop Nantes research areas of excellence, and in particular to think and plan the Health and Industry of the future. It offers students new training opportunities, combining different approaches, different knowledge and practices. 

Nantes Université is a sustainable and committed institution and one of the driving forces behind societal development. With a global and outward-looking culture, it promotes innovativeness and openness: open science, open research, open education, open innovation.

Nantes Université has strong values that are an integral part of its identity: it is based on renewed democracy, is environmentally responsible, inclusive, invests in gender equality, guarantees academic freedom, and ensures that its students and staff have the best study, research and working conditions for their on-going professional development on all Nantes Université’s campuses, in Nantes, Saint-Nazaire and La Roche-sur-Yon.

Committed at the regional, European and International level, Nantes Université works in synergy with public, private, socio-economic and cultural stakeholders. As a member of the European University for Wellbeing (EUniWell), it contributes in building a European Education Area and achieving the United Nation’s Sustainable Development Goals.

entityDescription: Meta Materials Europe was founded in Greece in November 2021, with its headquarters located at Marousi, Attica (VAT Number 801681292). It operates as a subsidiary of Meta Materials Inc. (NASDAQ: MMAT), which is based in Canada and the United States. META delivers previously unachievable performance, across a range of applications, by inventing, designing, developing, and manufacturing scalable, sustainable, highly functional materials and intelligent surfaces. To date and in the foreseeable future, Meta Materials Europe's exclusive activity is to provide research and development (R&D) services in engineering and technology, on behalf of its parent company. These services include antenna and other electromagnetic device design (e.g. metamaterials) for telecommunications, biomedical, and radar applications, as well as the development of artificial intelligence and medical imaging computational algorithms. Furthermore, as part of its research and development services, Meta Materials Europe participates in research proposals for Greek and European funding programs.

entityDescription: MF Research Labs is a startup focusing on cutting-edge GNSS research and consulting. We specialize in GNSS snapshot receivers, which enable GNSS tracking using unprecedentedly small amounts of energy. For instance, a GNSS receiver could run several years using a single coin cell battery, as our former research at ETH Zurich shows. MF Research Labs innovates both in software and hardware areas. One of our current goals is to enable real-time maximum likelihood GNSS positioning. Maximum likelihood positioning is a more robust positioning method than classical least-squares positioning. Also, maximum likelihood positioning allows for easy integration of GNSS spoofing mitigation capabilities, whereas current receivers can usually only detect GNSS spoofing, but not recover their position.

entityDescription:
Dutch Butterfly Conservation, the name De Vlinderstichting uses outside the Netherlands, was founded in 1983, with conservation and restoration of the Dutch butterfly fauna as its chief aims. Since then, it has extended those aims to include dragonflies and moths. Furthermore, our area of activity has grown over the border, where we now work with sister organisations in Europe. Conservation is of great urgency, because the numbers of these insects have been decreasing drastically since the beginning of the twentieth century. Our work is only possible with the help of more than 1500 volunteers, and the financial support of those who donate to our cause, at present, numbering some 6000.
The key to protecting insects is protecting the habitat they live in. We collect large amounts of data on insects and use these data as input for (spatial) modelling to identify suitable habitat, but also advise on proper management.

Arthur Strategies & Systems, headquartered in Amsterdam, and part and tradename Arthur’s Legal B.V. is an international research-based strategic and legal organisation incorporated in 2001, covering the unique combination of technology, strategy, impact, ethics and rule of law, focusing on (inter)national, regional and global strategy and policy aspects in this Digital Age. It has a global practice with multiple relevant ventures, programs and projects in the EU, UK, EEA and USA in the public, private and public-private sectors, on sovereignty, safety, security, privacy, critical infrastructures where sensitive data (either personal, non-personal, confidential, proprietary or otherwise) is the common denominator, as well as digital identity, data sharing, people-centricity, nuances of trust, trustworthy cyber-physical ecosystems of ecosystems, dynamic assurance and accountability.
For once, it is member of the EU Alliance of Industrial Data, Cloud and Edge, leading both the taskforce on digital sovereignty, and the taskforce on cybersecurity. Furthermore he is advisory board member, security advisory board member, ethical board member, data protection officer respectively partner in more than 25 European projects that are partially co-funded by the European Commission and for the other part funded by Arthur Strategies & Systems itself. Also, it is one of the stakeholders of UKRI TAS-S: Trustworthy Autonomous Systems Node in Security, where its director, Arthur van der Wees is chair of the Advisory Board.
Arthur Strategies & Systems are not consultants, but practitioners. It does not only talk, but actually walks the talk in real-life as it believe it is all about walking the talk (while continue to talk). We already do this for more than 20 years, and will continue our straight road forward. Arthur Strategies and Systems has created and deployed a novel collaborative and co-creative approach, which we call the Collaboration Framework Methodology. In short, it caters for trust between multiple partners such as multi-vendor, multi-sector and multi-data sources collaborations, where each is working together with each other; not working for each other. We have supported several hundreds of customers in several thousands of deals where digital data, communication, spectrum, IT, software, cloud, OT, edge, far edge/IoT, service levels, data processing, cyber-physical or other digital ecosystems were the subject matter, both in the public and private sector and both from vendor/supply-side as from demand/customer-side.
We have developed and successfully deployed various common reference models, methodologies and tools. These are proprietary of Arthur’s Legal and are and have been deployed both in the public and private sector and both from vendor/supplier-side as from customer/user-side. For once, Arthur Strategies & Systems creates and help design, enable and facilitate advanced trusted data sharing (TDS). This includes sharing contextual data, attributes, information and knowledge, based on trust, for optimising tactical and operational availability, usefulness and performance as well as increased security, safety and sustainability of the particular system, its subsystems, components, connectors, sensors and the like, as well as their respective interdependencies, throughout their entire - individual, combined and holistic - life cycles. Data sharing – or better, the lack of data sharing – is one of the most discussed and most urgent topics in almost all domains and sectors, and in the Space Sector including its supply chain ecosystems in particular.

entityDescription:
Agcurate BV is a Dutch earth observation company, which has expertise in the software development and AI in the agriculture domain. We leverage satellite imagery (SAR and multispectral) and additional data sources (climate, soil properties) to offer comprehensive insights into the cultivation cycle and support agricultural operations. Using machine learning and deep neural networks, we classify land cover and crops, estimate yields, and employ biophysical crop models to monitor soil water balance and detect irrigation needs. Generative AI enables us to adapt and generate data for regions with limited data availability.
Via our AI co-pilot FieldOps, we help consumer packaged food producers to monitor their return on investment on agricultural operations consistently, by providing them with actionable insights on their fields using satellite imagery and AI. We aim to make the agriculture investable, sustainable and resilient against the climate change.

entityName: Society for Conservation Biology Italy Chapter
entityDescription:
The Society for Conservation Biology Italy Chapter (Società di Biologia della Conservazione) constitutes the primary scientific entity of reference in Italy for professionals and experts in biodiversity conservation. The society advocates for diversity, equity, and inclusivity.
The Chapter's objectives are as follows:
- Promote membership in the Society and participation in Chapter activities.
- Advance scientific research in the field of conservation biology through an interdisciplinary approach.
- Support the professional development of individuals engaged in the field of conservation biology at both national and international levels.
- Raise awareness and engage civil society in conservation biology topics through communication and scientific outreach activities.
- Advocate for the positions of the Society and the Chapter regarding national and international public policies.
- Assist in decision-making processes and assessments within the context of environmental sustainability for biodiversity conservation.
- Uphold a high level of professional integrity and expertise in the field of conservation biology.
